nodes.label: PRD: Pet CRM + Booking + Membership
nodes.rationale: Spec for unified pet-retail platform (shop, grooming, pet hotel, aquarium) replacing disconnected walk-in/sales workflows.

nodes.label: Pet CRM (owner + pet profiles)
nodes.rationale: One CRM record shared across shop/grooming/hotel/aquarium; pet is a first-class entity linked to owner; schema is owners 1-N pets. Merge duplicate profiles, CSV import, special-needs flags.

nodes.label: Unified resource-calendar booking engine
nodes.rationale: Design seam: ONE scheduling engine — grooming slots, hotel nights, aquarium visits are resource types with capacity rules. Deliberate single-seam decision to avoid N booking subsystems; conflict detection blocks double-booking; buffer time; calendar shape to be prototyped before build.

nodes.label: Grooming booking
nodes.rationale: Service catalog with duration/price/staff skill, online + walk-in booking, groomer preference, add-ons (nail/teeth/de-shed), waitlist refill, daily queue.

nodes.label: Pet hotel / boarding
nodes.rationale: Room/kennel inventory with capacity + overbooking block, daily board roster checklist, check-in/out flow with deposit/ID/vaccine verify, extras, peak pricing/weekend surcharge, photo updates.

nodes.label: Aquarium maintenance services
nodes.rationale: Maintenance/installation visits, job sheets with tank size/history, monthly aquarium service plans; Phase 2 scope.

nodes.label: Shop / POS tie-in
nodes.rationale: Attach sale to pet profile for purchase history, reorder reminders, repeat-purchase rate by category, auto-suggest consumables from pet + last purchase.

nodes.label: Membership & loyalty
nodes.rationale: Retention engine: Silver/Gold tiers with points per spend, earn/redeem across shop + services, prepaid packages, referral bonus, birthday perks, churn list win-back coupon blasts.

nodes.label: Points ledger
nodes.rationale: Ledger accrue/redeem is transactional with sales/bookings; invariant math tested. Prototyped before build.

nodes.label: Prepaid packages ledger
nodes.rationale: Prepaid packages (e.g. 5 grooms, 10 hotel nights) = cash upfront; auto-applied at checkout; reference redeemable service SKUs; transactional decrement.

nodes.label: Vaccine gate
nodes.rationale: Boarding/hotel booking + check-in blocked when vaccination missing/expired; manager-role override requires audit log; vaccine expiry alerts drive rebooking. Risk-reduction mechanism.

nodes.label: Vaccination records
nodes.rationale: Owner-uploaded vaccination docs stored with expiry dates; compliance driver for boarding check-in.

nodes.label: Reminders & notifications
nodes.rationale: SMS/WhatsApp/email via pluggable provider; versioned templates; 24h + 2h pre-appointment, vaccine-expiry, grooming-due, pickup alerts; confirm/unconfirmed status; magic confirm/reschedule links; no-show tracking + fee rule. Risk: reminder fatigue → preference center.

nodes.label: Payments & deposits
nodes.rationale: Deposits for hotel + no-show protection; online payment + receipts; payment webhooks.

nodes.label: Reporting & admin dashboard
nodes.rationale: Occupancy, revenue, retention, bookings, top pets/services; calendar by resource (groomer/room/specialist).

nodes.label: Staff roles & permissions
nodes.rationale: Store owner/manager, receptionist/booker, groomer, hotel caretaker, aquarium specialist, customer; role-gated override for vaccine gate.

nodes.label: API contracts (REST/JSON + webhooks)
nodes.rationale: Customer, Pet, Booking, Stay, Job, MembershipAccount, Notification as REST/JSON; webhooks for payment + reminder delivery status.

nodes.label: Multi-branch readiness
nodes.rationale: branch_id on all entities now, but Phase 1 is single-branch operations — forward-compatible without build cost.

nodes.label: Named module boundaries
nodes.rationale: Ten modules: customers, catalog (services/rooms/packages), scheduling, hotel, aquarium-jobs, pos-link, notifications, loyalty/membership, payments, reporting.

nodes.label: Phase 1 scope boundary
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 = CRM + grooming/hotel booking + reminders + simple membership; aquarium jobs, advanced loyalty, and online storefront deferred to Phase 2.

nodes.label: Out-of-scope items
nodes.rationale: Full e-commerce storefront (Phase 2; only reorder reminders + POS link in Phase 1), vet/medical records beyond vaccination/allergy, multi-branch rostering/payroll/accounting, IoT tank monitoring, GPS pet tracking, native mobile apps.

nodes.label: Cross-line upsell paths
nodes.rationale: grooming -> hotel bath-before-pickup; hotel -> food reorder; aquarium sale -> maintenance plan.

nodes.label: Success metrics
nodes.rationale: Rebooking rate, no-show rate, occupancy, membership penetration, repeat-purchase interval, NPS.

nodes.label: Pet data consent & compliance
nodes.rationale: Consent for pet photos (stay photo updates); vaccination doc storage with expiry.

nodes.label: PetCo README (current build state)
nodes.rationale: Documents the implemented SvelteKit scaffold: CRM, booking engine, vaccine gate, membership, reminders; Phase 1 subset of the PRD.

nodes.label: SvelteKit + Postgres + Drizzle stack
nodes.rationale: SvelteKit 2 SSR w/ runes (Svelte 5), PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM + postgres.js, bcryptjs session cookie auth, Vitest.

nodes.label: CRM module (implemented)
nodes.rationale: Owner + pets with species/breed/weight, allergy/behavior/aggressive flags, vaccination record, vaccine status badge, history.

nodes.label: Booking module (implemented)
nodes.rationale: Single calendar engine for groomer slot / hotel room resources; conflict detection blocks double-booking; create/reschedule/cancel/check-in/check-out/no-show/completed; free-slot finder for grooming.

nodes.label: Vaccine gate (implemented)
nodes.rationale: Hotel bookings and check-in blocked when pet vaccination missing/expired; exercised end-to-end at the booking API.

nodes.label: Membership module (implemented)
nodes.rationale: Points ledger (earn/redeem), tier auto-upgrade, prepaid packages sold & redeemed against bookings.

nodes.label: Reminders module (implemented)
nodes.rationale: Pre-2h/pre-24h reminder scan, notification queue/log, channel preference (email default); transport is a delivered-stub — wire a gateway in runNotificationDispatcher.

nodes.label: Scheduling engine + vaccine tests (engine.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: Vitest pure-logic unit tests for scheduling overlap, active-status rules, vaccine status; conflict + vaccine gate also exercised end-to-end at booking API (409).

nodes.label: SvelteKit HTML shell (app.html)
nodes.rationale: SvelteKit SSR shell; loads Google Fonts Plus Jakarta Sans + JetBrains Mono; data-sveltekit-preload-data=hover.

nodes.label: robots.txt (allow all crawling)
nodes.rationale: Default permissive robots policy — all user agents, no disallow rules.

nodes.label: favicon.svg — default Svelte logo (not a paw print)
nodes.rationale: The stock Svelte brand swoosh (title=svelte-logo, orange #ff3e00 with white inner path) — the scaffolded brand mark was never replaced with a custom PetCo paw-print icon.
